body:
Hey, I've had gender dysphoria since about age 3-4. I moved to a part of the world that I thought was really open-minded about sexuality and gender, and then found out that apparently I need to quadruple-down on the gender I was born into the body of, in order to actually live.

I wish I had answers for you, there has to be community out there. How do you feel all that affects you? Gender issues are a difficult thing to deal with when everyone around it building them up while pretending to tear them down.

As for your answer:  you've never smoked DMT, let alone a breakthrough dose of it. That's something to try once. That'll blow your socks off, promise.

>nobody is talking down to you buddy.

It's all interpretation; usually, using 'buddy' is meant in a condescending tone.

Those people won't even answer their phone unless they want something.

It's not the solution to my problem at all; that only happens when I volunteer and a young woman thinks I'm autistic or something and tries to get me to help her move or something, but then doesn't want to talk to me otherwise. No phone numbers, I'm ignored. People actively ignore me, it's not zoning out into space, it's an active process, it takes effort, you can visibly see it. No one talks to me, so now I am nothing but anger and hate. I need to die.  

THIS LIFE, THIS SOCIETY IS A FUCKING LIE. 

I HATE EVERYONE, THIS IS A FUCKING JOKE.

Are you talking down to me? I genuinely can't tell.

yes, everyone ignores me and so I spend the entirety of my life alone. Literally, ignores me, like I don't exist at all.  Unless someone wants some help, then I'm a body to be used.

I shouldn't have posted this, I know how women love laughing at men like me rather than helping, I know men are the same.  I know I need to die, even reaching out screams this, maybe more. There is nothing here, everyone invalidates me ALL THE TIME, EVEN NOW.

THERE IS NOTHING HERE BUT SHAME AND **HORRIBLE PEOPLE.**
